name: image-to-miniature
readme: Image to printable miniature: Hunyuan3D 2.1, UltraShape, TRELLIS.2, Pixal3D and Hi3D behind one web UI on port 7860, with STL/3MF print prep. Use a 48 GB GPU (A40, RTX A6000, L40S); Hi3D at 1536 needs 80 GB. Not built for Blackwell GPUs (RTX 5090, RTX PRO 6000, B200). Weights download to /workspace on first use.
